CYCLE_SUBTITLE: Songahm 3  •  Self-Defense  •  Board Break  •  Speed Sparring

warmup.mindset: 60 seconds, eyes closed or soft focus. Name today's goal out loud.
warmup.mobility: Hip circles, leg swings (front/side), ankle rolls
warmup.activation: Kneel-to-stand hip drive reps, then pogo hops (priming the front kick)
warmup.stance: Weighted low lunge hold, 1 minute: tall posture, knees hover an inch or less off the floor. Go straight into form stances.

sparring.drill: #1 Round Kick on the bag as fast as you can: foot up and down quick.
sparring.conditioning: High-low round kicks, 20 sec each leg, belt tied around the target. Record your count.

seg3.label: Forms — Songahm 3
seg3.detail: Moves 15–18: L Low Block → R Reverse Punch → L #3 Jump Front Kick (KI-HAP) → L Reverse Punch. Mirrors segment 4 on the other side. Group 2 (new to Songahm 3, moves 1-14): stay on moves 1-14 and work speed and power.

seg4.label: Board Break
seg4.detail: Start kneeling, stand up and front kick, driving the hips forward. 30 seconds each leg: 5 kicks on the bag, then 1 attempt at the board, repeat non-stop.
seg4.note: Board level is individualized: the student's own size and ability. Level up only after 3 consecutive first-try breaks. Any miss means stay at the current board.

seg5.label: Self-Defense — Body Lock and Bear Hug
seg5.detail: Shadow Monster in pairs, 60-second turns. The shadow body-locks or bear-hugs. Defender scores 1 for turning and squaring up with arms up, 1 for breaking the arms and escaping. Shadow scores when the defender loses balance and a hand or knee touches the floor. No technique is taught yet. Keep it playful and match partners by size.

dailyChallenge.standard: Rep counts each time a knee drives to the chest. Hands under shoulders, hips level, no piking.
dailyChallenge.phase: Baseline test: establish your own starting number

ALL_CLASSES.cue: Coach's Note: Board level is individual. Celebrate the student who levels up as much as the one who lands a perfect first-try break.
